en: Vintage sepia postcard showing two black‑and‑white photographs of ancient Greek funerary reliefs framed like small temples. The left image depicts a standing warrior in armor within a niche; the right image shows a seated figure in a similar architectural frame. Greek and French captions identify the subjects, and at the top appears the bilingual title "ΑΘΗΝΑΙ — ATHÈNES." There is a postal cancellation mark dated 1902 and a handwritten signature or note in purple ink.
